about: The current primary screen (7.3, #140): its rows join the ring's as output after its tail (x/y#77 is only on screen; lines counts the rows read, blank ones never). While the alt screen is active (DCH_ST_ALT), or from a master before #140 (DCH_ST_ERR), the answer is the ring's alone: no error, no new why, no "alt", lines the ring's
